name: spider-web
description: High-velocity native GTK4/Wayland Kanban, Code Review pipeline, and productivity analytics desktop application for Hyprland Linux.
author: emirkefi

scripts.build:p2p: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin spiderweb-core && cp -f src-tauri/target/debug/spiderweb-core ./spiderweb-core
scripts.build:native: tsc && vite build && node scripts/bundle-native.mjs && gcc -O2 native/main.c -o spiderweb $(pkg-config --cflags --libs gtk4 webkitgtk-6.0) && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin spiderweb-core && cp -f src-tauri/target/debug/spiderweb-core ./spiderweb-core
